title: VaxBook rule set snapshot and engine contract
description: Go structs in ruleset/ and engine/ are the source (SAD §3). This schema checks shape. null is never valid; an optional member is omitted; members added after S1 are optional. Content checks live in ruleset.Validate and engine.Validate. They include the keywords the Go decoders do not enforce (enums, minLength, minItems, uniqueItems, the Id pattern). The Input schema accepts every Input that Evaluate assesses, so ⚪ INVALID_DATE (A9) stays reachable for a client that validates against it. Documents are I-JSON texts (RFC 7493): unique member names and well-formed Unicode (no unpaired surrogate escapes, no invalid UTF-8). A schema cannot express this, so the Go decoders reject such a text as a decode error. The root is a rule set snapshot; $defs Input and Output are the engine's input and output (engine slice S2 subset).

Span.description: An age, interval, offset or buffer as an ISO 8601 duration with one designator: P<n>D days, P<n>W weeks (7 days), P<n>M months (day of month clamped to the month end), P<n>Y years (12 months); n in 0..999, no leading zeros, upper case. Compound durations are not accepted yet.

Date.description: A civil date YYYY-MM-DD from 0001-01-01 to 9999-12-31 that exists in the proleptic Gregorian calendar. The pattern alone checks this, leap years included, so a validator that treats format as an annotation (the draft 2020-12 default) accepts exactly what the engine decodes.

illustrative.description: A fixture or demo rule set, not medically verified; the publish path never sets it.

minIntervalFromFirst.description: Minimum time since dose 1 (SAD §5.2); added in engine slice S2.

RecalledDate.description: A date as the user remembers it (GLOSSARY: Recalled date).

value.description: YYYY-MM-DD for precision day, YYYY-MM for month, YYYY for year; absent for unknown (a dose record) and none (the birth date). Any string is accepted (I-JSON, see the root description); engine.Validate reports one that does not parse as INVALID_DATE, and a value with unknown or none as UNEXPECTED_VALUE (⚪ on a dose record, input error on the birth date).

doseNumbers.description: Disease ID → the dose number the user entered for that disease (F04.1); added in engine slice S2. engine.Validate reports a key that is not one of the record's diseases as UNKNOWN_REFERENCE.

DoseNumber.description: A user-entered dose number. Any JSON number with an integral value (1, 1.0, 1e0) is an integer here and decodes in Go.

seriesUsed.description: The candidate series after step 3 (SAD §5.3), in rule-set order, complete ones included; omitted when step 3 did not run. Added in engine slice S3a.

estimated.description: Present, and true, only when the result rests on an imprecise or missing date, a level-4 dose or an implied dose; added in engine slice S2.

ReasonParams.description: Every reason parameter; each code uses the members SAD §5.4 lists for it. Typed: IDs and enums are strings, counts are integers, lists are arrays; no booleans. Members are added additively.
